_README: Read by core/cycle_profile.py. HUMAN-tunable only, like config/scheduler.json,
config/step_priority.json and config/model_window.json.
TWO PROFILES, BY WALL-CLOCK HOUR.
day    06:00-22:00  the full cycle. The cloud is primary for batch work and
the qwen3:8b window (config/model_window.json) is allowed.
night  22:00-06:00  lean. qwen3:8b is FORBIDDEN outright; anything that needs
it is appended to memory/deferred_batch.json and picked up
by the first day cycle instead.
WHY 8b IS FORBIDDEN AT NIGHT AND NOT MERELY DISCOURAGED. Measured on this box:
qwen2.5:3b and qwen3:8b never coexist in 4GB of VRAM, and 8b does not fit even
alone (3.32GB of 5.75GB resident, the rest on CPU). A night run that loads it
pays a full reload on the way in and another on the way out, out of a step's
ceiling, with nobody awake to see it degrade. The day has a human nearby.
AN OBSERVATION THAT MAKES THE 'lean' LABEL PARTLY UNTRUE, SAID OUT LOUD RATHER
THAN LEFT TO BE DISCOVERED. `allowed_priorities` below is [CRITICAL, NORMAL],
and config/step_priority.json defines exactly those two values and no third.
Measured: CRITICAL 16 steps, NORMAL 38, total 54 of 54. So the night profile's
priority filter excludes NOTHING, and the whole of its leanness is the 8b
prohibition and the deferral. It is written this way because that is what was
specified, and the filter is real machinery that will bite the day a third
priority exists -- but today it is a no-op, and a config that quietly implies
otherwise would be the sort of decoration this repo keeps deleting.
To make the night genuinely lean on STEPS, either add a third priority to
config/step_priority.json (and its README forbids a scale, deliberately), or
set night.allowed_priorities to ["CRITICAL"] here -- which would run 16 of
54 steps, close to what survival mode already does (17 of 55). A human's
call, not the system's.
Boundaries: a window is [start, end). 06:00 is day, 22:00 is night. The night
window wraps midnight and the resolver handles that explicitly.

day.why: a human is awake; the expensive model and the cloud are both affordable

night.why: nobody is watching; 8b is forbidden and its work is deferred to the first day cycle
